data.name: La Villa del Ensueno
data.address: C. Florida 305, Prados del Nilo, 45500 San Pedro Tlaquepaque, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
This laid-back hotel is 9 km from the Regional Museum of Guadalajara, 8 km from Templo Expiatorio del Santísimo Sacramento and 7 km from Parque Agua Azul.
Bright, modest rooms and suites with tile floors provide Wi-Fi access, satellite TV and en suite bathrooms, as well as air-conditioning, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Some have terraces and/or minifridges.
Amenities include a bar, a garden and 2 outdoor pools, plus a hot tub, a restaurant and a gift shop. Breakfast and parking are available.
